text: The Lessee shall pay Rs. 90,000 towards the refundable security deposit, equivalent to three months' rent of Rs. 30,000.
A security deposit of Rupees Forty Thousand only shall be kept by the Lessor until the tenancy ends.
The Lessor has received ₹2.5 lakh as advance deposit against the monthly rent of ₹25,000.
There is no lock-in period during the first year, and the tenancy may be ended by either party at any time.
The Lessee shall not leave the premises before completing the first six months of the tenancy.
A written notice of thirty (30) days shall be given by the Lessee to terminate the tenancy.
The Lessor may terminate the tenancy by giving the Lessee 3 months' notice.
The agreed rent will go up by 7.5% every year during the term of this Agreement.
The Lessee shall pay a refundable deposit of Rs. 80,000 and a non-refundable fee of Rs. 5,000 for administrative charges.
A rent hike of 10 percent shall apply after the first year of occupation.
The Lessee shall keep the flat clean, pay the electricity bill of about Rs. 1,200 per month, and hand back the keys on the last day.
The tenancy may be ended by the Lessee on 15 days' notice after the lock-in of 5 months.
